query:
SELECT 
            c.id,
            c.username,
            c.email,
            COUNT(t.id) as tip_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(t.amount::decimal), 0) as total_amount
        FROM creators c
        LEFT JOIN tips t ON c.id = t.creator_id 
            AND t.created_at >= $1
        WHERE c.email IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY c.id, c.username, c.email
        HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 0
